messages:
mira: Quick heads-up — embeddings+rerank Python sampleapp is flaky on async. Sync rerank returns list-of-objects but async batch helper returns dict-of-arrays and sometimes shuffles order. Breaks typed postprocess in examples.

mira: Sync expected:
```python
out = client.rerank(items)
# out -> [ {'id':'a','score':0.9}, {'id':'b','score':0.2} ]
```

mira: Async problematic:
```python
out = await client.rerank_batch(items)
# out -> {'ids': ['b','a'], 'scores': [0.2,0.9]}  # nested + arrival-order
```

jchen: Repro'd. Two bugs: (1) parity between legacy rerank and unified vectors (different shapes), (2) async batcher concatenates by arrival order.

sam: Suggest standardizing SDK to always return List[RerankHit] and adding a preserve_order option to async batcher. Also add normalize_rerank_response() adapter for compatibility.

ashley: Also saw an auth issue: if app supplies async token refresh, the async client doesn't await the callback in the retry path and retries 401 with stale token. I'll patch auth provider to await awaitables and refresh before retry.

mira: File refs: examples/embeddings_rerank/sampleapp.py, sdk/python/redwood/client/_async_batcher.py, sdk/python/redwood/auth/provider.py. I'll file tickets and add a short e2e CI job to run examples sync+async.

jchen: Filing tickets: RDX-4601 (rerank shape parity), RDX-4602 (async preserve_order), RDX-4603 (auth awaitable handling). Will attach repro snippets.

sam: I'll PR typed model + adapter. ashley please tag me on auth PR so sampleapps get updated.

mira: Thanks, closing thread after PRs linked.
